provider_family: Michigan Secretary of State / Michigan Voter Information Center (MVIC)

endpoints.purpose: Official Michigan page linked by the SOS for Nov. 3, 2026 general election results.
endpoints.observation: Cloudflare challenge response (Cf-Mitigated: challenge); no election result payload obtained.

endpoints.purpose: Public multi-state race search; intended follow-up /api/v2/race/{ID}/region_results.
endpoints.observation: Cloudflare 502 error; a second direct request at approximately 04:26 UTC timed out without response. No race IDs or results retrieved.

endpoints.purpose: Official SOS results index; identifies a 2026 November General Election results link and describes local election data as county-posted.
endpoints.observation: Index page reachable, but following its results link reaches the MVIC 403 endpoint above.

endpoints.purpose: Potential official election result page probed as a fallback.
endpoints.observation: Direct request timed out after 20 seconds. Not confirmed as the operative endpoint for this election.

limitations: No live county vote totals could be independently fetched from an unauthenticated public API in this probe; do not treat missing totals as zero votes.
The official SOS site links the 2026 general results to MVIC, but the endpoint returned an automated Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403). No attempt was made to bypass it.
CivicAPI, the preferred potentially reusable provider, returned HTTP 502 and then timed out. Its race search and region_results schema could not be verified.
Michigan SOS says local election data may be posted on county websites; its election results index does not itself provide a statewide county API contract.
license: No data license for a machine-readable feed was verified. The SOS public pages provide public election information; confirm reuse terms for any fetched third-party or county data.

preferred_verified_source.provider: Reported election returns via The New York Times
preferred_verified_source.message: 83 counties with published returns. Source times apply to the published race feed; individual local update times are not supplied. Unofficial counts; no forecast or expected-vote estimates are included.
